description: Defines an abstract class ResourceLoader for dynamically loading resources, including methods for loading resources, retrieving URLs, parsing XML configuration files, and managing resource loader instances with caching.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for loading resources with support for dynamic class loading, XML configuration parsing, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Abstract method to load a resource as InputStream given its location.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the URL of a resource given its location.

methods.name: fullLocation
methods.description: Constructs the full resource location string, incorporating environment variables and prefixes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceLoader with name, prefix, and environment name.

methods.name: getXmlRootElement
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the root element of an XML document.

methods.name: readXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root element of an XML document.

methods.name: getXmlDocument
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the XML Document object, utilizing cache.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from classpath resource.

methods.name: makeLoader
methods.description: Creates a ResourceLoader instance based on XML configuration element.

methods.name: invalidateDocument
methods.description: Clears caches related to a specific XML filename.
